BiblicalUsage: Zebuwl is a lofty dwelling, an exalted home, and Solomon uses it for the temple itself when he says he has built God a house to dwell in forever. Isaiah turns the same word into a question, asking God to look down from the habitation of His holiness and glory.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God is at home in heaven and still comes down to dwell with His people, and that is the wonder of the temple.
